blocks.prompt: Team name
Teammates, first and last names
Your Blade's name
Theme
Your role: Blade, Body, Assembly, or Blade and Assembly on a team of two
Target across, in
Target full height, tip to the top of the collar, in
Collar height, in (0 for no collar)
Screenshot of the team's Armory folder with your file in it
Team sketch on paper: top view and side view, every part labeled
Team sketch, second page
Which edge hits first, and why it grips instead of sliding off

criteria.text: Team, role, Blade name and theme are set

levels.label: Complete
levels.short: Team, role, name and theme set
levels.descriptor: Team name, teammates, a role, the Blade's name and a theme are all filled in. A team of two has a Blade and Assembly person.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One or two of team name, teammates, role, Blade name or theme are missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: None of them are filled in.

criteria.text: The team sketch is a plan someone could model from

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A top view and a side view, every part labeled with how it is made (one new steel blade, printed parts, leftovers, hex, collar), the spin direction and the hitting edge marked, and the size written, plus a sentence on why that edge grips.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One of these is missing: a view, the part labels, the hitting edge, the size or the sentence.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A drawing with no labels or sizes, or only one view.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No sketch handed in.

criteria.text: The size targets fit the rules

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Across 5.00 in or less, full height 3.00 in or less, and collar 0.50 in or less, all filled in.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One target breaks a rule or is missing.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or more targets break a rule or are missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No targets.

blocks.prompt: Retired: file upload (files are graded from Armory)
Screenshot of your part in SolidWorks
File that gets made: blade DXF or body sliced plate file
Assembly: screenshot of the mates and the model
Mass, g: blade from Mass Properties, body from the slicer, hardware from the scale
One change you made, and the number that changed
Retired: level pick (Ready, Strong or Stretch)
How this student moves through it: Day, Step or List

criteria.text: Your role's file is checked in to Armory and opens

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The part or assembly for your role, opened from your team's Armory folder, holds the finished model.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The right file opens, but a feature is missing or broken.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A file for a different part, or a model barely started.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing for your role checked in to Armory.

criteria.text: What gets made is ready to make

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Blade: one closed outline at full size Mr. Pina can cut. Body: a sliced file that opens and prints the body. Assembly: every team part inserted and mated to the spin axis.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One small fix before it can be made: a stray line, a wrong setting, one part not mated.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Handed in, but it cannot be made or checked as it is.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No DXF, sliced file or mates screenshot.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The screenshot shows the whole part or assembly, clear enough to read.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Part of it is off screen or too small to read.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No screenshot.

criteria.text: Your mass and one change, with numbers

levels.label: Complete
levels.short: Mass and a change, both numbered
levels.descriptor: A mass in grams from the right source, and one change named with the number before and after.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The mass or the change, not both, or a change with no number.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A guess for the mass and a change with nothing specific in it.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No mass and no change.

blocks.prompt: Screenshot of your team's whole Blade assembled, isometric
Measured across, in
Measured full height, tip to the top of the collar, in
Measured collar height, in
Measured bare hex above the collar, in
Mass: blades, g
Mass: body, g
Mass: hex, collar and bolts, g
What did not fit, and what you changed

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The screenshot shows the body, the blades, the hex and the collar together in one assembly.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One part is missing from the assembly.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Only one or two parts in the assembly.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No screenshot of an assembly.

criteria.text: The stack is measured off the assembly

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Across, height, collar, bare hex and the three masses are all filled in and match the assembly. A number over a rule still earns this.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One number is missing or does not match the assembly.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or more are missing, or they were clearly guessed.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No numbers.

criteria.text: What did not fit, and the fix

levels.label: Complete
levels.short: Problem and fix, with a number
levels.descriptor: Names what was off, what was changed and a number, or the number worried about most and what it came out to.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names what was off but not what was done about it.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A sentence with no part and no number in it.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing written.
